description: NaAl(PS₃)₂ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fdd2 space group. Na is bonded to six S atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent AlS₆ octahedra, corners with six equivalent PPS₃ tetrahedra, and edges with two equivalent AlS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 11°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.94-2.96 Å. Al is bonded to six S atoms to form AlS₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent PPS₃ tetrahedra, edges with two equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent PPS₃ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 11°. There are a spread of Al-S bond distances ranging from 2.41-2.48 Å. P is bonded to one P and three S atoms to form distorted PPS₃ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one AlS₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent NaS₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one AlS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 75-82°. The P-P bond length is 2.25 Å. There are two shorter (2.03 Å) and one longer (2.06 Å) P-S bond length. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one P atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Al, and one P atom. In the third S site, S is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Al, and one P atom.
